description: Machine-readable analytics event spec. Mirrors the event catalogue in docs/templates/ANALYTICS_SPEC_TEMPLATE.md (copied to the product's analytics spec). src/analytics.js only sends events and properties listed here. Property types: string, number, integer, boolean. Optional 'values' restricts a property to an allowed list.

privacy.pii: none: no emails, phone numbers, names, precise location or free text in properties; the distinct ID is a random anonymous UUID
privacy.retention: Set the PostHog project's event retention to the shortest period that still covers the hour-48 decision, and record the chosen value in the product's analytics spec. Delete the project when the experiment is killed.

internal.description: true for team/test traffic; excluded by the documented filter

app_opened.description: First render of the entry screen.

activation.description: The user reached the product's activation moment, as defined in the PRD. Fired at most once per anonymous ID.

screen_id.description: Screen ID from the design inventory, e.g. S-02

core_action_completed.description: The user completed the product's core action, as defined in the PRD.

screen_id.description: Screen ID from the design inventory

duration_ms.description: Time from action start to completion

error_unhandled.description: An unhandled client error reached the global error handler. Never send the error message or stack (may contain user input).

screen_id.description: Screen ID where the error happened
